incidents.observed_error: The second candidate was syntactically typed but systemically misbound: the producer targeted an alias relation for an outbox operation, update effects could be empty, trigger row images crossed relations, derivations omitted sources and closed profile names concealed rather than expressed computation.
incidents.detection_method: Sol parsed and structurally validated the artifact, then performed an operand-level audit with two bounded independent read-only analyses. The candidate was rejected before sealing or staging.

correction.action: The misbound candidate was preserved only as negative evidence. A fresh builder now emits all twenty-two programs from closed operands, and the validator plus nineteen-class hostile packet rejects wrong targets, omitted effects, illegal row images, unproduced values and opaque operations.
correction.prevention_control: Typed syntax is insufficient: acceptance rederives effects and graphs, compares the exact body AST envelope and runs relation-, source-, trigger-, lock- and authority-mutation attacks after resealing evidence.

incidents.expected_invariant: The exact post-commit five-source pre-worker-dispatch receipt must pass before any cohort worker begins task work.
incidents.observed_error: Sol spawned three bounded cohort agents before generating the exact post-commit dispatch receipt. Sol immediately paused all three before task work and no owned file changed until the corrected receipt passed.
incidents.detection_method: The orchestrator recognized the ordering error at dispatch time, paused every worker and verified the shared workspace remained unchanged before constructing the receipt.

correction.action: The agents remained paused while a fresh five-source receipt was generated and corrected; only its passing successor authorised resumption.
correction.prevention_control: Generate and inspect the exact-head pre-worker-dispatch receipt before calling the agent spawn primitive; pause and audit immediately if ordering is violated.

incidents.expected_invariant: A receipt's expected task HEAD must be copied from the exact forty-character git rev-parse result and independently compared with Git rather than trusted as a self-reported evidence string.
incidents.observed_error: The first corrected runtime state named an incorrect full candidate SHA, yet the receipt passed because that evidence string was not Git-verified. Sol detected the mismatch before resuming workers and replaced it with d2ed77c177f1f1dbb217984caea904732903df9c.
incidents.detection_method: Sol compared the receipt text with a fresh git rev-parse HEAD, found the discrepancy and reran the receipt after correcting the runtime state.

correction.action: The same candidate remained unchanged. The runtime state was corrected to the exact Git HEAD, the five-source receipt reran and passed, and only then were workers resumed.
correction.prevention_control: Every dispatch receipt must independently resolve and compare Git HEAD; an expected-head evidence string cannot establish its own truth.

incidents.expected_invariant: A detached exact-head verifier checkout must use a destination short enough for every versioned path, complete successfully and pass the clean-worktree preflight before reviewer dispatch.
incidents.observed_error: The first attempt used a descriptive review-worktree destination that made an already-versioned evidence filename exceed the Windows path limit. Git reported Filename too long and could not reset the index; no usable or registered worktree remained.
incidents.detection_method: The git worktree command failed before dispatch; Sol then verified that the requested destination did not exist, the path was not registered and the immutable candidate HEAD remained unchanged.

correction.action: The failed destination remained absent and unregistered. The distinct successor uses the established short rNN destination while binding the same full candidate SHA and reruns the clean-worktree preflight before dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Windows verifier worktrees use the short rNN root naming pattern; descriptive tranche identity belongs in the review packet and receipt rather than the filesystem destination.

incidents.expected_invariant: The replacement body architecture must independently prove the complete coordinator transition state machine, one internally consistent non-consumed retention census, current-transaction-only non-temporal effects and exact recovery/signature/privilege/enum closure without relying on a self-generated baseline equality check.
incidents.observed_error: The committed candidate passed its local suite but the fresh exact-head veto found four under-closed semantic surfaces. Resealed owner privilege widening, retention enum widening, producer owner substitution and removal of the producer event-membership assertion were admitted by both semantic and structural validation.
incidents.detection_method: A fresh read-only independent reviewer inspected the exact twenty-four-path packet at f51f5b65dd77d9282e5325a5e4f17edd872d14df, ran the prescribed passing checks, challenged semantic closure with four independently resealed mutations and returned one revision_required decision while leaving the candidate unchanged.

correction.action: The exact candidate remains rejected. Sol froze a four-part replacement contract covering coordinator and retention semantics, current-XID transaction fencing, independent scalar and privilege closure, and hostile tests that do not depend on regenerated-baseline equality.
correction.prevention_control: A body-architecture candidate cannot be accepted until a fresh exact-head veto independently demonstrates semantic rejection of resealed privilege, enum, signature, proof-removal, coordinator, retention and transaction-scope mutations after all deterministic checks pass.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every orchestrator runtime state must enumerate every worker-pool resource required by the active Ariadne settings, including a required pool with zero active or stale instances.
incidents.observed_error: The first exact-veto recovery precommit runtime state listed only the native recovery pool and omitted the configured deepseek-flash-workers inventory. The preflight failed closed with worker_slot_inventory_missing before staging or commit.
incidents.detection_method: The generated receipt returned revision_required with the exact missing worker-slot reason; Sol preserved it, added the required zero-instance inventory in a distinct v3 runtime state and obtained a passing receipt.

correction.action: The failed receipt remains immutable. The distinct v3 runtime state includes both the required deepseek-flash-workers inventory and native recovery inventory with empty active/stale lists and produces one passing five-source receipt.
correction.prevention_control: Copy the complete configured worker-slot inventory into every runtime state even when a required pool has zero instances; treat zero inventory as evidence rather than omission.

incidents.expected_invariant: A repository module that imports the scripts package must be invoked or imported with the repository root on Python's module path, following the existing AER-0058 prevention control.
incidents.observed_error: While inspecting generator command interfaces, Sol invoked the schema module by filesystem path. It failed closed at import with ModuleNotFoundError before executing a generator, reading a candidate or writing any artifact.
incidents.detection_method: The command returned a non-zero status and exact import error inline; Git state remained unchanged and the distinct correction imported the module through the repository package path successfully.

correction.action: The failed invocation is preserved. Sol imported the schema module through the repository package path, confirmed build_schema was available and made no repository write.
correction.prevention_control: Invoke import-dependent scripts as python -m scripts.<module> when they expose a module CLI, or import their public API from the repository root; never execute them by filesystem path.

incidents.expected_invariant: After the recurrent package-path failure AER-0066, the import-dependent artifact builder must be invoked through python -m from the repository root.
incidents.observed_error: Sol again invoked an import-dependent scripts module by filesystem path. The builder completed only its in-memory contract step, then failed closed while importing the schema module before either generated artifact was opened or written.
incidents.detection_method: The command returned ModuleNotFoundError inline. The distinct repository-root package-module invocation then wrote both generated artifacts and exited successfully.

correction.action: The failed command is preserved. Sol invoked the builder as python -m scripts.raisa_provider_free_unmounted_durability_function_trigger_body_architecture_builder from the repository root; the validated contract and schema were then generated successfully.
correction.prevention_control: The direct-path exception is removed for this tranche: every Python file under scripts is invoked as a package module unless a recorded preflight proves it has no package imports on every execution path.

incidents.expected_invariant: The historical API Spine regression cohort should collect and pass on the recovery source HEAD before it is used as corroborating evidence for an unrelated unmounted architecture descendant.
incidents.observed_error: One API Spine integration module could not collect because it imports the removed _BERNIE_SESSION_STORE. After that file was explicitly isolated, 535 tests collected and 530 passed; five stale preflight or inventory assertions disagreed with already-present idempotency headers, GraphQL resolvers, OpenAPI command paths and SDL inventory.
incidents.detection_method: Sol ran all fifty-eight API Spine test files serially, preserved the collection traceback, reran the remaining fifty-seven files, collected the exact 535-test population and verified every implicated app, API-document and test path was byte-unchanged from recovery source HEAD 7ad40bd337ac6433bd6cc84653dd5883679ed13b.

correction.action: The baseline defect is contained as non-candidate evidence. This tranche makes no app, router, OpenAPI, GraphQL SDL, idempotency-index or historical-test repair and relies on its passing architecture-specific suites plus scoped API Spine invariants.
correction.prevention_control: Future cross-programme regression gates must run a source-HEAD baseline preflight and separate pre-existing collection or expectation drift from candidate-caused regressions before using the suite as acceptance evidence.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every design label naming the current deterministic candidate digest must equal the builder-derived contract and generated schema digest before exact-HEAD reviewer admission.
incidents.observed_error: The rebuilt contract and schema bound digest sha256:8871663b121dedff089b7517406f8223a3df2153bce66716d624b2f321e20dde while the design still labelled rejected predecessor digest sha256:631773f9112e7804f5e2ea15b04d4cd4cb4c699502d3491b516d57d14e6f35d5 as current.
incidents.detection_method: Sol compared the successful builder module --check output, generated contract and schema digest with the design before dispatching the fresh reviewer; the mismatch was corrected before the prepared review worktree was used.

correction.action: The design now names the builder-derived rebuilt contract digest. The unused review worktree must be replaced by a fresh exact-HEAD worktree after the correction is committed.
correction.prevention_control: Before reviewer worktree creation, compare every current-candidate digest label against the builder --check output and generated contract/schema digest values.

incidents.expected_invariant: A passing replacement must make receipt replay conflict-safe and integrity-rederived, registration create or reload its head and compare the complete baseline, retention join every aggregate proof to the exact non-consumed generation census, and critical signature and trigger fields fail independently of canonical section equality.
incidents.observed_error: The fresh exact-HEAD veto found three P1 gaps and one P2 gap despite 128/128 passing tests: receipt replay ignored retained conflicts and did not rederive the receipt digest; registration had no head insert and compared only the generation row on replay; retention aggregate sets and key count were not generation-identity complete; and owner, security-definer, volatility, timing and deferrability mutations emitted only normative_section_mismatch.
incidents.detection_method: A fresh read-only reviewer inspected exactly twenty-eight allowlisted paths at 5ea59e14184b26dfa0b8d3a6ebaf28b39c04fb9d, ran the complete passing packet, challenged R1 through R4 directly and returned one revision_required decision with exact unchanged HEAD and clean worktree postflight.

correction.action: The exact candidate remains rejected. Sol froze R5A conflict-safe receipt replay, R5B complete registration head/baseline semantics, R5C identity-joined set and per-generation key coverage, and R5D field-independent signature/declaration validation before replacement implementation.
correction.prevention_control: No body candidate advances on passing generated tests alone. Fresh veto must directly challenge replay conflict and digest derivation, every registration baseline member, consumed and duplicate-key retention counterexamples, and field-specific signature/trigger mutations after resealing.

incidents.expected_invariant: Reviewer environment controls must use valid tool-specific Boolean spellings while preserving the exact read-only command and worktree boundary.
incidents.observed_error: The reviewer set RUFF_NO_CACHE=1. Ruff rejected the invalid Boolean spelling before analysis and made no repository change.
incidents.detection_method: The reviewer preserved the rejected invocation in its terminal report, reran with RUFF_NO_CACHE=true, obtained a passing result and verified exact unchanged HEAD plus empty git status.

correction.action: The invalid invocation was discarded. The reviewer reran the exact Ruff path set with RUFF_NO_CACHE=true, passed, and completed clean exact-HEAD postflight.
correction.prevention_control: Reviewer packets and follow-up commands use literal supported Boolean values true or false for Ruff environment controls; numeric truthy spellings are not used.

incidents.expected_invariant: A reviewer must transcribe every allowlisted Ruff path exactly so the prescribed read-only check runs against the complete intended candidate surface.
incidents.observed_error: The reviewer first transcribed one underscore-delimited Python filename with hyphens. Ruff returned E902 because that nonexistent path could not be opened; no candidate file was analysed or changed by that failed invocation.
incidents.detection_method: The reviewer preserved the E902 result, corrected the path to the packet's exact filename, reran the complete Ruff path set successfully, and verified unchanged exact HEAD plus an empty worktree status.

correction.action: The invalid invocation was discarded and the complete exact packet path set passed on a fresh invocation without changing HEAD or worktree state.
correction.prevention_control: Reviewer commands must be copied from the exact packet or programmatically checked for path existence before tool execution; manually transformed path spelling is forbidden.

incidents.expected_invariant: A passing candidate must keep retained receipt and terminal replay source-independent on every control-flow path, independently prove the complete committed lifecycle packet before appending or replaying a recovery anchor, and make duplicate set-key pairs structurally invalid.
incidents.observed_error: The fresh exact-HEAD veto found two P1 gaps and one P2 gap despite 192/192 passing tests: coordinator replay inherited an unconditional source outbox read; recovery-anchor append/replay copied generation/checkpoint fields without lifecycle, receipt, audit or key proof; and the two set-key-pair schema branches lacked uniqueItems true.
incidents.detection_method: A fresh read-only reviewer inspected the exact allowlisted candidate at 5a3c5b5118f80153d545bf30ae9db99acb187cd7, ran the complete passing packet, directly challenged source-independent control-flow effects, anchor evidence derivation and duplicate structural key pairs, then returned revision_required with exact unchanged HEAD and clean worktree postflight.

correction.action: The exact candidate remains rejected. Sol froze R6A path-local source-independent replay, R6B complete independently derived recovery-anchor proof and R6C structural key-pair uniqueness before replacement implementation.
correction.prevention_control: No replacement advances on passing generated tests alone. Focused hostile tests and fresh veto must trace per-path relation effects, substitute or omit every anchor evidence class and independently validate duplicate key pairs against the generated Draft 2020-12 schema.
